title: 第三三九章 本座要他安全回来若是不然第三三八章 远离红尘
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 时隔一百多年，李水生再次回到灵台山。
灵台山依旧紫云盘旋于上空，但山间的森林却是发生了变化，不再是呈现出紫色。
它们郁郁葱葱，似是有些许灵智。
感受到李水生到来，这一根根大树花草顿时有了变化。
他们扭动枝条，清扫落叶，露出一条干净的山道来，让李水生从容上山。
一根藤蔓蔓延洞府，将洞府打扫得干干净净。
李水生轻声道：“看来，因为我的缘故，此地已经变成了福地，此地灵植已经开始慢慢成精了。”
他手中浮现炼魂锤，轻轻对着空中一锤。
这些灵植没有任何反应。
“只是刚刚有了些许灵智，还不算拥有神魂吗？”
“又或是其他缘故，不会受到炼魂锤的影响？”
“不过也好，至少这个家，是能住得了。”
他走进洞府，激活一张千里传音符，吩咐司辰在不影响收支平衡的情况下，每一年给他送来一些醒神丹，便在此处安心住下。
“神魂的修行，没了天材地宝属实难上加难。”
他是符修，还修了钉头七箭和玄阴摄鬼大法，还是自证金丹，神魂化形。
“本身神魂就极其强大，远超其他金丹后期，都如此艰难，其他人想要走通这条路，确实没什么机会。”
不是他不想要更好的丹药，而是醒神丹已经是最好的修复神魂丹药了。
更好的修复神魂丹药，炼制材料在千年之前就已经绝种了。
玄冥历八百年。
李水生服下一颗醒神丹，盘膝坐在一棵古松之下，缓缓修复神魂。
一甲子的时间，他从能挨三锤变成了能挨一百二十锤了。
这是一个巨大的进步。
而他的神魂，也是变得越来越小。
之前那庞大如山的神魂麒麟，如今变得只有房子大小。
“浓缩才是精华！”
李水生才道完，又忍不住道：“可这也太慢了！”
“这般努力修行，也才能挨一百二十锤，一万锤，真的是金丹能做到的吗？”
“还得是突破到金丹圆满，才能知道个大概。”
“算算日子，祖师这一世应该还有一两百年寿元吧？”
“先练着吧，反正时间对于我来说，并不关键。”
就在这时，金丹中期的陆痴忽然前来，他顺着山道上来，在松树下寻到了李水生。
“师尊，林师叔快要寿尽了。”
李水生点头起身，“是该去送他一送。”
陆痴跟上，“师尊，傲天鹰已经在山下等着了。”
两人踏上傲天鹰的背，化作一道黑色的影子，飞空而过。
辰金道宫，那斑驳的剑海在这一刻显得无比安宁，万剑都安然躺在安静无比的道宫中。
李水生来到辰金道宫正殿，满头白发的林天艰难抬头，“玄冥师兄，你终于到了。”
“你到了，我也能安心去了。”
李水生上前，“莫说那么多，你的剑呢，可准备好了？”
林天的面前横着七柄真君剑器，他伸手抚摸中间的斩魔剑。
“此剑名为斩魔，跟随我四百载，我已经将我的剑法和金丹传承都留存在其中，就拜托师兄了！”
content_en:
After more than a hundred years, Li Shuisheng returned to Lingtai Mountain again.
Purple clouds are still hovering in the sky above Lingtai Mountain, but the forests in the mountains have changed and are no longer purple.
They are lush and green, and seem to have some intelligence.
Feeling the arrival of Li Shuisheng, the big trees, flowers and plants suddenly changed.
They twisted the branches and swept away the fallen leaves, revealing a clean mountain path for Li Shuisheng to climb up the mountain calmly.
A vine spread across the cave, cleaning it clean.
Li Shuisheng said softly: "It seems that because of me, this place has become a blessed place, and the spiritual plants here have begun to slowly become spirits."
A soul-refining hammer appeared in his hand, and he struck the air lightly.
These spiritual plants showed no reaction.
"I just gained some intelligence, doesn't that count as possessing a soul?"
"Or is it because of other reasons that it won't be affected by the soul-refining hammer?"
"But it's okay, at least this home is livable."
He walked into the cave, activated a thousand-mile transmission talisman, and ordered Si Chen to send him some awakening pills every year without affecting the balance of income and expenditure, and then he settled here with peace of mind.
"The cultivation of the soul will be even more difficult without the treasures of heaven and earth."
He is a talisman cultivator, and he has also practiced the Seven Nail Head Arrows and the Xuanyin Ghost-catching Technique. He has also attained the golden elixir and transformed his soul into another form.
"The soul itself is extremely powerful, far superior to other golden elixirs in the later stages. It is so difficult. Others who want to take this path really have no chance."
It's not that he doesn't want better pills, but the Awakening Pill is already the best pill to repair the soul.
Better soul-restoring elixirs, the refining materials became extinct thousands of years ago.
Xuan Ming Li eight hundred years.
Li Shuisheng took an awakening pill, sat cross-legged under an ancient pine, and slowly restored his soul.
In a matter of minutes, he went from being able to take three blows to being able to take one hundred and twenty blows.
This is a huge improvement.
And his spirit became smaller and smaller.
The spiritual unicorn that was as huge as a mountain before was now only the size of a house.
“Condensation is the essence!”
Li Shuisheng just finished speaking and couldn't help but said: "But this is too slow!"
"If you practice so hard, you can only get one hundred and twenty blows. Is it really possible for ten thousand blows to be achieved by the golden elixir?"
"You have to break through to the perfection of the golden elixir before you can get a rough idea."
"Counting the days, the Patriarch should have one or two hundred years to live in this life, right?"
"Let's practice first. Time is not critical to me anyway."
At this moment, Lu Chi, who was in the middle stage of Jindan, suddenly came. He walked up the mountain road and found Li Shuisheng under the pine tree.
"Master, Uncle Lin is about to expire."
Li Shuisheng nodded and stood up, "It's time to send him off."
Lu Chi followed, "Master, Aotian Eagle is already waiting at the foot of the mountain."
The two of them stepped on the back of the Proud Eagle and turned into a black shadow, flying through the air.
In Chenjin Dao Palace, the mottled sea of ​​swords seemed extremely peaceful at this moment, and all the swords were lying peacefully in the extremely quiet Dao Palace.
Li Shuisheng came to the main hall of Chenjin Dao Palace. Lin Tian, who was full of white hair, raised his head with difficulty, "Brother Xuanming, you are finally here."
"Now that you're here, I can feel at ease."
Li Shuisheng stepped forward, "Don't say so much. Where is your sword? Is it ready?"
In front of Lin Tian were seven True Lord swords. He stretched out his hand to touch the demon-slaying sword in the middle.
"This sword is called Demon Slaying. It has been with me for four hundred years. I have preserved my swordsmanship and golden elixir inheritance in it. Please leave it to my senior brother!"
